int_name: N BODINE ST & W BRISTOL ST

result.summary: A narrow residential street with row houses on one side and a fenced area on the other. The environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings, curb ramps, and has significantly degraded pavement surfaces.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway and sidewalk areas have significant cracking and uneven surfaces, creating trip hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points for pedestrians at the intersection, increasing exposure risk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street where cars are parked

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and repair sidewalk sections to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection corners to provide accessible transitions.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poorly defined, lacking marked crossings and traffic control devices. Sidewalks are present but narrow and cluttered with debris, while parked vehicles create sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: Debris and large objects on the sidewalk restrict pedestrian movement.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install painted crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at intersections to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear debris and obstructions from the pedestrian walkway.

result.summary: The image shows a residential and commercial intersection with sidewalks but lacking basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The roadway surface is uneven with visible patching, and parked vehicles near the corner may limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the street at this intersection.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped transitions at the corners creates a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The road surface is uneven and heavily patched, which can be a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection using paint or bollards to improve sightlines for all users.

result.summary: This residential street provides basic sidewalk access but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic control at the visible intersection. Parked vehicles along both curbs create significant visual obstructions, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway to see oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the intersection corners block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs at the foreground intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or signage leaves pedestrians unprotected when crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt in the roadway and sidewalk areas creates potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking near the corner.
